mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, condition_field, logic, controls, api_url
mapper.select: SELECT condition_field, unnest(string_to_array(cc.logic,',')) as logic, controls, api_url, condition_field_name, request_method, param, label, value FROM cfg_condition cc WHERE condition_field = #{conditionCode}
SELECT condition_field , condition_field_name, request_method, controls, api_url, param, label, value, search_key, remote_label FROM cfg_condition WHERE is_deleted=FALSE ORDER BY index ASC

SELECT condition_field , condition_field_name, request_method, controls, api_url, param, label, value, search_key, remote_label FROM cfg_condition WHERE is_deleted=FALSE and condition_field in ('dictPlatform','shop','destCountry','skuNo') ORDER BY index ASC

SELECT condition_field , condition_field_name, request_method, controls, api_url, param, label, value, search_key, remote_label FROM cfg_condition WHERE is_deleted=FALSE and condition_field in ('dictPlatform','shop','destCountry','logisticsChannelId') ORDER BY index ASC
